description: USU-GAIM assimilates ionospheric measurements with a physics-based background model and a Kalman-filter formulation. It adjusts global plasma-density estimates using real-time or near-real-time observations. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented configuration and available observations constrain the resolution of the assimilated state. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue.
